idea-plugin.name: Support for Spring Security
idea-plugin.description: Spring Security filter chains for Phantom, in Java: a gutter icon on each SecurityFilterChain bean shows its position among the project's chains, its securityMatcher and its authorizeHttpRequests rules in order. Errors for configurations Spring Security rejects at startup: requestMatchers after anyRequest(), and a chain that matches every request placed before other chains. Does nothing in modules without Spring Security.
